notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
I just fixed several things:
- corrected lots of typos and misspellings in English and Polish (again, hopefully the last time)
- fixed small scenes with conditional dialogue (if Alice looks good in glasses)
- fixed glitch with white strip appearing sometimes under Jake's image
- fixed Ending 6, in which Emma was similing - changed to sad

I think this will be the last update to this game.

PS:
If you enjoyed daily school life in Jake's Love Story, look forward to next announcement :)

notes.title: Update 1.2 available! - Feedback request
notes.notes:
I'm happy to say that this update brings quite a lot. I'd like to ask for your feedback about few things.

As I read the reviews, you mentioned that English is still bad, so it's been corrected (again) by another proofreader, so please take a look and let me know if it's alright this time.
I sincerely apologize for inconvenience, but as non-native speaker, I couldn't tell that previous change wasn't good enough.

Small bugs, typos etc. were also fixed. Thank you everyone for your feedback!
You're really great, I'd be more than happy if you keep reporting issues, bugs and so on, or just share your opinion about the game :)

Looking back, the game changed a lot since release, so I wonder... Would you like me to add/change something more? Write in the comments below, and I will see if it's possible :)

Also, this update adds Brazilian Portuguese translation, thanks to my friends at [url=https://twitter.com/StdBlueBowling]@StdBlueBowling[/url] :)

Have a great summer everyone!

Best,
Mikołaj Spychał

(*image unconnected to update, just a small art; reminder - we have artwork section in Community Hub ;) )

PS: We're doing our best so my next game - NEKOKORO would be free from mistakes.
